value.rationale: The explicit arbitrary-periodic-waveform Fourier response fills a transport-fluctuation gap between thermal ratchet current analysis and zero-thermal-noise RTP dispersion. The strict negative sign for every harmonic and the strictly increasing wavenumber penalty for persistent propulsion are structural, parameter-uniform predictions; passive no-persistence limit is recovered but not novel.
